title: Nonvanishing of the expanded polynomial
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell \ne 0$, and let $\gamma$ be a nonzero vector in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^{n\ell}$. Group its coordinates into $n$ blocks of length $\ell$, and use the chosen basis of the degree-$\ell$ binary extension field to interpret each block as a coefficient $a_i$ in that field. Then the polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i X^{i+1}$ over the binary extension field is nonzero.
